title: ailanthus altissima f. rubra
intro: Ailanthus altissima f. rubra, commonly known as the Red Ailanthus, is a variety of the Tree of Heaven (Ailanthus altissima) plant, a deciduous tree native to Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help alleviate conditions such as arthritis and other inflammatory diseases. The therapeutic actions of Ailanthus altissima f. rubra include its ability to act as an anti-diarrheal, an anti-inflammatory, and an antioxidant, due to the presence of various bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
